title: US Finance Controller
description:
MUST TO HAVE - CANDIDATES SHOULD BE ONLY US PERMANENT RESIDENT OR CITIZENS . Position: US Finance Controller 
 Location: US
 Reports to: Group Finance Controller 
 Role Profile - This is a hands-on leadership role requiring a combination of technical accounting expertise, financial-control discipline, commercial understanding and strong stakeholder-management skills. The ideal candidate will be comfortable operating in a fast-growing, multi-entity and globally distributed organization and will bring a strong focus on accuracy, cash, controls, profitability and scalable finance processes . 
 Role overview - Lead accounting, financial reporting, controls and compliance for the Groups US operations. Ensure accurate IND-AS and US GAAP reporting, effective cash management and client billing, while partnering with global finance and operations teams to improve profitability and support growth. 
 Key responsibilities Own monthly, quarterly and annual close, financial statements and group reporting. Design, document and maintain controls over revenue, billing, receivables, procurement, payments, payroll, journal entries and financial reporting. Establish clear approval limits, segregation of duties and system-access controls. Ensure timely and accurate invoicing, supported by contract terms, collection reports, volume data or other agreed billing evidence. Drive collection of the company’s client receivables and monitor corporate DSO, aging and disputed balances. Oversee US banking activities, cash forecasting and payment controls within delegated authority. Lead cash forecasting, working-capital management and banking controls. Coordinate federal, state and local tax compliance with qualified external advisers. Maintain internal controls, coordinate external audits and oversee tax compliance with advisers. Monitor client-level profitability and support pricing, budgeting and forecasting. Support acquisitions and post-acquisition finance integration. 
 Competencies 10–15 years of accounting and finance experience. Experience owning financial close, external audits, balance-sheet controls and financial reporting. Experience in an RCM, healthcare services, technology-enabled services or outsourced business-services organization. Familiarity with multi-entity accounting and cross-border or offshore delivery structures. Experience with an established ERP platform and advanced Excel-based analysis. Demonstrated ability to lead distributed teams and communicate effectively with senior stakeholders.

Key Skills: Financial Reporting,US GAAP,Consolidation,Controllership,Financial Controllership,Financial Statements,Finance Control,IGAAP
